title: 化学实验入门与玻璃仪器
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/163_化学实验入门与玻璃仪器.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/163_化学实验入门与玻璃仪器/src.py

points.K11: 冷凝管：下进上出不封口

shots.scene: 欣欣站在摆满玻璃仪器的实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a teaching lab bench lined with clean glassware, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第一课：化学实验入门与玻璃仪器。
overlay: 化学实验入门与玻璃仪器

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一排操作图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of icons: a balance, a pipette, a funnel and a flask, each with a small shield icon.
shots.narration: 这一章学基本操作，和每一步的安全要点。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一次走进化学实验课，看着满桌仪器发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat and goggles stands at a bench full of glassware, looking puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次上化学实验课。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿烧杯量溶液，圆底烧瓶在台面上一歪
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours liquid into a beaker to measure it while a round-bottom flask beside him tips over on the bench.
shots.narration: 拿烧杯量体积，圆底烧瓶还歪倒了。

shots.scene: 小研走过来扶住烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student catches the round-bottom flask and sets it on a cork ring, smiling at him.
shots.narration: 小研说：先把仪器认清、用对。

shots.scene: 书本上的分子模型与动手实验
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open textbook with a molecule drawing, an arrow to hands holding a flask at a lab bench. No text.
shots.narration: 书上的分子，亲手做一次才真懂。

shots.scene: 三个问号：这是什么、做完没有、怕空气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle with a question mark, a flask with a clock and a sealed flask with an air icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 是什么？做完没？实验技术来回答。

shots.scene: 课前复习萃取、色谱、蒸馏原理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student reading notes with icons of a separatory funnel, a chromatography plate and a distillation setup. No text.
shots.narration: 课前复习原理，带着问题进实验室。

shots.scene: 台阶：基础技术到专门技术
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: steps going up, basic glassware icons on the lower step and a complex apparatus on the top step. No text.
shots.narration: 先学基础操作，再学专门技术。

shots.scene: 王老师在实验台边示范，阿杰举手提问
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator demonstrates at a tidy bench while the young male student raises his hand to ask.
shots.narration: 跟着有经验的老师学，不懂就问。

shots.scene: 阿杰在门口看洗眼器标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student at a lab entrance looking toward an eyewash sign on the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 进实验室，先找洗眼器。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an emergency shower sign above a pull handle, a student pointing at it. No text.
shots.narration: 再看紧急喷淋在哪里。

shots.scene: 废液桶、碎玻璃盒、固废桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a waste liquid container, a broken glass box and a solid waste bin side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 废液碎玻璃放哪个容器，也要问清。

shots.scene: 王老师在本实验室现场讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks students around their own lab, pointing out the equipment.
shots.narration: 各实验室不同，会用设备就是安全。

shots.section_title: 烧杯锥形瓶：刻度只估量
shots.scene: 大小不同的烧杯一字排开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of beakers from very small to very large. No text.
shots.narration: 烧杯有大有小，按用途选大小。
overlay: 烧杯锥形瓶：刻度只估量

shots.section_title: 烧杯锥形瓶：刻度只估量
shots.scene: 烧杯做反应、转移液体、当水浴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three uses of a beaker: mixing a solution, pouring into another vessel, holding warm water around a test tube. No text.
shots.narration: 能做反应、转移液体，还能当水浴。

shots.section_title: 烧杯锥形瓶：刻度只估量
shots.scene: 烧杯刻度旁一个约等号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: close-up of beaker graduation marks with an approximately-equal icon, a measuring cylinder with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 烧杯刻度只能估个大概。

shots.section_title: 烧杯锥形瓶：刻度只估量
shots.scene: 锥形瓶摇动不洒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a conical flask being swirled by hand, the liquid staying inside thanks to the narrow neck. No text.
shots.narration: 锥形瓶口窄不易洒，刻度同样不准。

shots.scene: 高高的量筒放在台面里侧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tall graduated cylinder standing at the back of the bench away from the walkway, a fallen cylinder crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 量筒又高又细，放在不易碰倒处。

shots.scene: 视线与凹液面最低处平齐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye level with the bottom of a curved liquid surface in a cylinder, a dashed line of sight. No text.
shots.narration: 视线放平，读凹液面最低处。

shots.scene: 试管放回试管架，试管夹夹住试管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: test tubes standing in a rack and a test tube holder gripping one tube near its mouth. No text.
shots.narration: 试管用完放回架，试管夹要配试管。

shots.scene: 【实拍】胶头滴管：挤扁、插入、松开吸液、移到新容器
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: fingers squeeze a rubber dropper bulb, dip the tip into water, release to draw liquid, then move it over another beaker.
shots.narration: 挤扁胶头，插入，松开吸液，再移走。

shots.scene: 加热试管，管口朝向无人处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a test tube held at an angle over a heater, its mouth pointing away from all people, a crossed-out tube pointing at a face. No text.
shots.narration: 加热试管，管口别对自己和别人。

shots.scene: 量筒和容量瓶放在加热板上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a graduated cylinder and a volumetric flask on a hot plate, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 量筒容量瓶这些量器，不能加热。

shots.scene: 两个一样的玻璃杯，一个是烫的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two identical glass beakers, one with invisible heat waves shown by an infrared-style glow, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 热玻璃和冷玻璃，看起来一模一样。

shots.scene: 用坩埚钳和隔热手套取放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tongs and a heat-resistant glove lifting a hot beaker onto a heat-proof mat. No text.
shots.narration: 用夹子或隔热手套取放。

shots.scene: 有易燃溶剂时明火打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solvent bottle with a flame pictogram next to an open burner flame, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 附近有易燃溶剂，不用明火。

shots.scene: 滴定管刻度从上往下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burette with an arrow along its scale pointing downward from the top. No text.
shots.narration: 滴定管刻度从上往下，读出加了多少。

shots.scene: 容量瓶配准确浓度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a volumetric flask with a single ring mark on its long neck and a matching stopper. No text.
shots.narration: 配准确浓度的溶液，用容量瓶。

shots.scene: 接近刻线时慢慢滴加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid rising quickly in the narrow neck of a volumetric flask, a dropper adding drops slowly near the mark. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶颈细，接近刻线要慢慢加。

shots.scene: 容量瓶放稳，塞子配套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a volumetric flask standing in a flask holder, its own stopper tied beside it, a mismatched stopper crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 颈长易倒要放稳，塞子要配套。

shots.scene: 抽滤瓶带侧管，只做减压过滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a filter flask with a side arm, liquid pouring out of the side arm when used as a beaker, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 抽滤瓶带侧管，只用来减压过滤。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先用夹子把抽滤瓶夹在铁架台上，再装上带垫圈的布氏漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands clamp a filter flask to a stand at its neck, then fit a porcelain filter funnel with a rubber adapter on top.
shots.narration: 头重脚轻，先夹稳抽滤瓶再装漏斗。

shots.scene: 普通漏斗垫折叠滤纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass funnel in a ring with folded filter paper, and filter papers of different sizes beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 普通漏斗常压过滤，滤纸孔越细越慢。

shots.scene: 粉末漏斗往瓶里加固体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wide-stem powder funnel in a flask neck, solid being added with a spatula. No text.
shots.narration: 加固体用粉末漏斗，用前用后洗净。

shots.scene: 分液漏斗分开两层液体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a separatory funnel in an iron ring with two liquid layers. No text.
shots.narration: 分液漏斗，分开两种不相溶的液体。

shots.scene: 塞子尺寸对、铁圈大小合适
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a funnel stopper of the right size with a check mark, an iron ring too small and one too large both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 塞子要配套，铁圈大小要合适。

shots.scene: 活塞装好，加水检查不漏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stopcock fitted into a funnel, water inside and no drips below, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 活塞装好、试过不漏再用。

shots.scene: 恒压滴液漏斗的平衡管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure-equalizing dropping funnel with its side tube highlighted, dripping steadily into a flask. No text.
shots.narration: 恒压滴液漏斗有平衡管，滴加平稳。

shots.scene: 弯头和平头药匙取固体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bent spatula and a flat spatula scooping solid, a spatula being bent hard crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 药匙取固体，轻拿轻用，别硬掰。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒放在架上，不滚落
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass stirring rod resting on a holder, a rod rolling off the bench edge crossed out, a thermometer beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 玻璃棒会滚要放稳，别当温度计用。

shots.scene: 研钵研磨固体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mortar and pestle grinding crystals into powder. No text.
shots.narration: 固体研成粉末，用研钵和研杵。

shots.scene: 表面皿和蒸发皿
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a watch glass holding a little solid and an evaporating dish holding wet crystals drying. No text.
shots.narration: 表面皿盛少量固体，湿固体放蒸发皿。

shots.scene: 圆底烧瓶放在软木圈上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a round-bottom flask resting on a cork ring, an unsupported flask rolling crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 圆底烧瓶受热均匀，要放在软木圈上。

shots.scene: 【实拍】把烧瓶夹子夹在瓶颈磨口处
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands fasten a clamp around the thick ground-glass neck of a round-bottom flask on a stand.
shots.narration: 夹在瓶颈磨口处，那里最厚最结实。

shots.scene: 铁架台重心落在底座上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stand with a flask clamped over the long side of its base, a stand loaded on the wrong side tipping over crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 重心落在底座伸出的一侧，防倾倒。

shots.scene: 磨口卡死，硬拧打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands twisting a stuck glass joint with force crossed out, an arrow to a teacher icon. No text.
shots.narration: 磨口卡住别硬拧，交给老师处理。

shots.section_title: 冷凝管：下进上出不封口
shots.scene: 回流冷凝管，蒸气冷凝流回烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reflux condenser on a flask, vapor rising and drops falling back down. No text.
shots.narration: 回流冷凝管，让蒸气冷凝流回瓶里。
overlay: 冷凝管：下进上出不封口

shots.section_title: 冷凝管：下进上出不封口
shots.scene: 【实拍】把进水管接在冷凝管下口，出水管接在上口
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands push a water hose onto the lower inlet of a condenser jacket and another hose onto the upper outlet.
shots.narration: 冷却水下口进，上口出。

shots.section_title: 冷凝管：下进上出不封口
shots.scene: 冷凝管顶端塞住，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a condenser top sealed with a stopper crossed out, the open top with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 冷凝管顶端绝不能堵上。

shots.section_title: 冷凝管：下进上出不封口
shots.scene: 压力憋在瓶里，危险
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed apparatus with pressure arrows building inside and a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 压力憋在里面，会酿成事故。

shots.scene: 色谱柱：带活塞的长玻璃管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long glass column with a stopcock at the bottom and a reservoir bulb at the top. No text.
shots.narration: 色谱柱是底部带活塞的长玻璃管。

shots.scene: 熔点管放进专用盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: thin capillary tubes sealed at one end, stored in a small box, a loose tube rolling on the bench crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 熔点管细小易碎，放在安全的地方。

shots.scene: 核磁管滴入溶液盖好管帽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dropper adding solution into a thin sample tube, then a cap placed on top, the tube in a rack. No text.
shots.narration: 核磁管滴入溶液，盖好管帽放稳。

shots.scene: 通风柜里的加热磁力搅拌器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume hood with a hot plate stirrer and a clamped flask inside. No text.
shots.narration: 反应多在通风柜里做，仪器也在这。

shots.scene: 旋钮与外接温度计
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hot plate stirrer dial with a question mark and an external thermometer probe in the liquid with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 旋钮温度未必准，要校准或接温度计。

shots.scene: 搅拌子转动，烧瓶被夹住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stir bar spinning fast in a clamped flask, an unclamped flask tipping crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 搅拌可能很猛，容器要夹住。

shots.scene: 加热时有人看守，用完关电源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student watching a heated flask, then switching off the hot plate, a heat icon still glowing on the plate. No text.
shots.narration: 加热不离人，用完关电源防余热。

shots.scene: 【实拍】双手把干燥器盖子水平推开
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: two hands slide the heavy glass lid of a desiccator sideways to open it, not lifting it up.
shots.narration: 开干燥器，盖子平推，别往上提。

shots.scene: 搬干燥器时拇指按住盖子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands carrying a desiccator with thumbs pressing the lid down, a sliding lid falling crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 搬动时按住盖子，防滑落打碎。

shots.scene: 放入热坩埚后留缝再盖严
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hot crucible placed inside a desiccator, the lid left slightly open, then closed. No text.
shots.narration: 放进很热的东西，先留缝再盖严。

shots.scene: 来不及洗的器皿泡在洗涤液里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used glassware soaking in a basin of soapy water beside the sink. No text.
shots.narration: 来不及洗，先泡在洗涤剂水里。

shots.scene: 【实拍】戴手套用毛刷和洗涤剂刷洗烧杯
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands scrub the inside of a beaker with a brush and soapy water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 第一步，用洗涤剂和毛刷刷洗。

shots.scene: 自来水冲、蒸馏水淋洗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beaker rinsed under tap water, then rinsed with a wash bottle of purified water. No text.
shots.narration: 再用自来水冲，最后蒸馏水淋洗。

shots.scene: 溶剂淋洗，废溶剂进废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small amount of solvent rinsing a flask over a labeled waste container in a fume hood. No text.
shots.narration: 需要溶剂冲的，废溶剂倒进废液桶。

shots.scene: 倒置晾干，顺便看有无裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: clean glassware hanging upside down on a drying rack, a magnifier checking a rim for cracks. No text.
shots.narration: 倒置晾干，顺便检查有无裂纹缺口。

shots.scene: 超纯水与自来水对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a purified water dispenser with a check mark and a tap with impurity dots, both pointing to a buffer bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 配溶液用超纯水，自来水杂质会干扰。

shots.scene: 【实拍】接纯水时把瓶子放在水槽里
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a bottle placed inside a sink under the outlet of a water purification unit, water filling it.
shots.narration: 接水时，瓶子放在水槽里，防溢出。

shots.scene: 看纯水机读数，异常报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water purifier with a blank display and a warning bell, an arrow to a teacher icon. No text.
shots.narration: 看一眼读数，偏低或报警就报告。

shots.scene: 更换滤芯，标签写日期
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a filter cartridge being replaced and a blank label with a calendar icon stuck on it. No text.
shots.narration: 更换滤芯，在标签上写上日期。

shots.scene: 烧杯、量筒、容量瓶三件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beaker with an approximately-equal icon, a cylinder and a volumetric flask with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 认清仪器，量准体积用量器。

shots.scene: 夹在磨口、冷凝管下进上出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clamp at a flask neck and a condenser with water arrows in at the bottom and out at the top. No text.
shots.narration: 夹磨口、下进上出、顶端不堵。

shots.scene: 洗净晾干、安全设施
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: clean glassware on a drying rack, an eyewash sign and a waste container. No text.
shots.narration: 洗净晾干，认清安全设施和废物桶。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在天平旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an analytical balance with a draft shield and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：天平的使用与称量。
